title: Borrow against a coin that’s minutes old
blurb: Borrow SOL against a pump.fun coin that’s minutes old. Keep the bag.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
You’re up on a coin that launched an hour ago. You want SOL, and you want to keep the bag.

On Curv Fund you borrow against it. Nothing gets sold on the chart.

Priced from its first block

Connect your wallet and every pump.fun coin in it shows up, even ones minted minutes ago.

We read each coin’s bonding curve on chain and work out its market cap ourselves. A coin can be seconds old and already have a loan on offer.

Your score sets your loan

Every coin gets a risk score from what’s on chain. The safer it reads, the more you can borrow, up to a third of the bag.

You see the rate before you borrow, and it stays the same after.

Keep the bag

Your coins lock in the on-chain program, and no admin key can move them. The SOL is yours to use.

Pay it back and the coins come straight back to you. $CURV creator fees fund the lending pool, so every $CURV trade adds to what can be lent.

Get the SOL. Keep the bag.

Borrow on curv.fund

What’s the first coin you’d borrow against? Tell me below.
